 LIVE India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Kohli, Gill dismissed; India in trouble
   Sat, 07 November 2026 
 Refresh   
 12:51 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Kohli, Gill dismissed; India in trouble 
 India 27-2 (5 ovs) vs New Zealand 134 | SCORECARD 
 The wicket of Kohli could force Rohit to change tactics and not take unnecessary risks in the next few overs. 
 Rohit keeps out the first two balls from Jamieson before he guides the third to thirdman for a single and Shreyas keeps out the last three balls. 
 In the next over, Rohit clips Duffy for a single before Shreyas smashes a wide length ball over the covers for a six. 
 He is beaten a couple of balls later trying to slash Duffy over point as the pacer gets some extra bounce and then ducks under a bouncer. 
 12:41 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Kohli, Gill dismissed; India in trouble 
 India 19-2 (4 ovs) vs New Zealand 134 | SCORECARD 
 Jamieson starts his second over with another superb delivery to beat Rohit on the outside edge. 
 But Rohit gets back at the tall pacer. He plays a cracking pull shot next ball for a boundary through square leg. 
 Rohit keeps out the next two balls before he steps out of his crease and attempts to smash it outside the ground but fails to connect. He sensibly defends the last ball with caution. 
 In the next over, Kohli guides Duffy on the off-side for a single followed by a wide down the leg side. 
 Rohit flicks Duffy uppishly on the leg side but ends up hitting it high on the leg side but it falls well short of the fielder running in from deep square leg. 
 Duffy gets the big wicket of his RCB team-mate Kohli, who hits it straight into the hands of the fielder in the covers to be dismissed for 7. 
 India in a spot of bother on 17/2 in the fourth over. 
 Shreyas Iyer flicks the last ball in the gap at midwicket as the fielder makes a sliding stop to keep the ball inside the ropes and concede just two runs. 
 12:30 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Shubman Gill out for first-ball duck 
 India 10-1 (2 ovs) vs New Zealand 134 | SCORECARD 
 A big early blow for India as captain Shubman Gill falls for a first-ball duck.  
 Jacob Duffy strikes first ball with a massive wicket of Gill to lift New Zealand.  
 The length ball swings away enough and Gill, looking to defend, gets the edge and Henry Nicholls at second slip does well to take a low catch to his right. 
 Virat Kohli offers no shot to the first ball he faces before he crashes a brilliant cover drive off the next to get off the mark with a four. 
 Kohli then clips Duffy past the fielder at square leg for a couple of runs followed by a block. 
 12:28 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Brar takes 4; New Zealand 134 all out 
 India 4-0 (1 ov) vs New Zealand 134 |  SCORECARD 
 New Zealand have been forced into a change. Blair Tickner, who was struck on the helmet by a bouncer, has been ruled out of the match with concussion with fellow pacer Matt Henry coming in as the concussion substitute. 
 The start of India's run chase has been delayed slightly because of some problem with the outfield. A small chunk of the grass behind where the first slip fielder stands has come out and the groundstaff are working to repair that patch. 
 Kyle Jamieson makes a perfect start with the ball. He beats Rohit Sharma on the outside edge with the back of length outswinger which moves away and go past the edge. 
 The next ball is again short but too wide as Rohit looks to cut but fails to get bat on ball. 
 Jamieson goes fuller and again some movement as Rohit is beaten once again on the outside edge. 
 The fourth ball is a beauty, movement and extra, as Rohit initially looking to push at it ends up trying to fend it away to be beaten four balls in a row. 
 Rohit learns from his mistake as he offers no shot to the fifth ball which is on length outside the off-stump. 
 Rohit gets off the mark with a boundary off the last ball, crashing the short wide ball past point for a four. That was a risky shot but Rohit will look to bat positively and not allow the bowlers to dominate. 
 11:49 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Brar takes 4; New Zealand 134 all out 
 Gurnoor Brar 
 New Zealand 134-all out (41 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Kamboj back into the attack. He starts with a bouncer as Blair Tickner is struck on the helmet as he misses the pull shot. 
 He is fine to continue after a mandatory concussion test. 
 Tickner takes a single down to long-on and Jacob Duffy mistimes the pull shot for another run. 
 Kamboj finishes off the New Zealand innings as he bowls Tickner with a full delivery. 
 New Zealand are bowled out for 134 in 41 overs in the match reduced to 47 overs per side due to a delayed start. 
 Gurnoor Brar starred with the ball for India with excellent figures of 4/30, while Auqib Nabi, Anshul Kamboj and Axar Patel bagged two wickets each. 
 11:40 
 India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI Live Score: Brar picks 4th wicket; NZ 9 down 
 New Zealand 132-9 (40 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Brar ends his spell with a deserved wicket. Smith pushes away from the body to a length delivery only to get the edge and is caught by Rohit Sharma at slip. 
 That is Brar's fourth wicket of the innings. 
 However, Jacob Duffy denies him the five-wicket haul by offering no shot to the last ball which sails through to the wicketkeeper. 
 An excellent outing with the ball for Brar, who bowled with a lot of pace, as he finishes with career-best figures of 4/30 in 10 overs including two maiden overs. 
 New Zealand struggling on 132/9 in 40 overs. 
 11:32 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Axar strikes again; NZ lose 8th wicket 
 New Zealand 129-8 (39 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 A confident shout for stumping by Rahul after Jamieson misses the swipe off Axar but the tall right-hander has managed to drag his feet back inside the crease. 
 However, Axar gets his man off the very next delivery. 
 Jamieson is beaten all ends up by a full straight delivery to be bowled for seven. 
 Blair Tickner gets off the mark with a single and Nathan Smith is struck on the pads by the arm ball which is clearly going down. 
 He keeps strike with a single from the last ball of the over. 
 11:30 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Santner, Mitchell perish; New Zealand 7 down 
 New Zealand 127-7 (38 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Axar rushing through his overs. He is firing it full and on the stumps as Jamieson defends the first five balls before managing just a single off the last ball. 
 Jamieson is looking to take on the pacers. The first ball from Brar is a half-tracker as Jamieson backs away and looks to swing it across the line but is beaten. 
 The next ball is full and this time the Kiwi No 9 hammers it through the covers for a four. 
 Another play and miss from Jamieson as he makes room and looks to pull it over the leg side. 
 A fiery well-directed bouncer from Brar as Jamieson misses the pull shot and is struck on the side of the helmet. 
 Brar from round the wicket as Jamieson pushes it to mid-on for a single followed by a wide and Nathan Smith defends the last ball. 
 11:18 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Santner, Mitchell perish; New Zealand 7 down 
 Gurnoor Brar 
 New Zealand 120-7 (36 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 That wicket has come at the right time for India. New Zealand were looking to accelerate at this stage but the wicket of Mitchell makes things worse for them. 
 Santner shows that he is capable with the bat as well. Brar tries the bouncer but Santner up to the task as he powerfully pulls it over square leg for a six. 
 Brar gets revenge off the very next delivery. Santner makes room to hit through the off-side but only manages the edge to be caught behind after scoring 31 from 38 balls. 
 Santner was looking to punch it square but was done in by the extra bounce from Brar, who grabbed his third wicket. 
 Kylie Jamieson throws his bat at a wide delivery only to get a thick outside edge for a single to thirdman. 
 11:13 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Mitchell out for 55; New Zealand 6 down 
 New Zealand 112-6 (35 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Brar back into the attack as India look to break the partnership. Mitchell gets lucky as he top edges the pull shot off Brar but the ball flies over thirdman for a four. 
 That boundary helps Mitchell go past the 50-run mark from 97 balls. He has battled hard in tough conditions against a fired-up attack to keep New Zealand in the hunt after a horror start. 
 A few words exchanged between Mitchell and Brar. 
 Mitchell keeps strike with a single off the last ball to deep point. 
 Axar doing a very good holding job with the ball, keeping his end tight to allow pacers to attack from the other. 
 Mitchell inside edges the first ball for a single and Santner cuts the fourth ball past point for one. 
 Mitchell brings out the reverse sweep but Kohli comes up with a diving stop at point to save some runs. 
 A frustrated Mitchell uses his feet and attempts to loft the spinner down but ends up offering a simple catch to Kamboj at long-off. 
 Mitchell walks back disappointed after a battling knock of 55 from 104 balls with five fours and two sixes. He added 59 runs from 90 balls for the sixth wicket with Mitchell. 
 11:04 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: New Zealand struggle past 100; India in control 
 New Zealand 105-5 (33 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Santner also looking for the boundaries to revive his team. After playing four dots in a row off Axar, the left-hander slog sweeps the spinner over midwicket for a six. 
 In the next over, Mitchell takes a single off Nabi to bring up New Zealand's 100, in the 32nd over. 
 The two batters pick a single each off Nabi to get three runs from the 32nd over. 
 Axar continues as Mitchell tries the reverse sweep but without a run again. He then plays the sweep for two runs to deep square leg followed by a single off the last ball. 
 10:56 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Daryl Mitchell, Santner steady New Zealand 
 New Zealand 92-5 (30 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Axar back into the attack after the drinks break. Mitchell dying to break free as he tries the reverse paddle but fails to connect and is struck on the pads. Wicketkeeper Rahul interested but Axar doesn't seem excited. 
 Mitchell again brings out the reverse but again to the fielder followed by another dot -- the fifth in a row. 
 The last ball turns away sharply as Mitchell looking to defend is beaten on the outside edge and wicketkeeper Rahul fails to collect and concedes a bye. 
 Nabi back into the attack. Mitchell pulls the first ball powerfully over the leg side for a six. 
 Two balls later, Mitchell has another big swing across the line but misses and the ball narrowly misses the stumps. He keeps strike with a single from the last ball of the over. 
 Good comeback from Nabi after giving away a six off the first ball to concede just one from the remaining five balls. 
 New Zealand are 92/5 in 30 overs at a run rate of just above three. 
 10:47 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Daryl Mitchell, Santner steady New Zealand 
 New Zealand 84-5 (28 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Arshdeep getting some extra bounce as Santner gets a thick outside edge trying to cut for a single to thirdman. 
 A high bouncer from Arshdeep which clears Mitchell by a long way and is ruled a wide for height. 
 Mitchell keeps strike with a single from the last ball as Arshdeep concedes three runs in his seventh over. 
 New Zealand are 84/5 in 28 overs. They will need to get a move on with each innings reduced to 47 overs because of rain. 
 Mitchell has looked to hit a few boundaries but he has been restricted to singles mostly to score 36 from 72 balls, while Santner has made 17 from 23 balls. 
 10:39 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Gurnoor Brar's double strike leaves NZ in a mess 
 New Zealand 81-5 (27 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Kamboj is back into the attack as Gill employers pacers from both ends. Santner misses the clip for a leg bye before Mitchell pushes the next to midwicket for a single. 
 Santner gets a thick inside edge as he looks to drive Kamboj but the ball misses the stumps to get the New Zealand captain a single. 
 Arshdeep from the other end also continues to be tight as he gives away just three singles in the 26th over. 
 In the next over, Santner steers Kamboj behind point for two runs to thirdman before he takes a single to point. 
 Mitchell plays a cracking pull shot bang off the middle but gets just one to deep midwicket before Santner takes one off the fifth ball. 
 10:28 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Gurnoor Brar's double strike leaves NZ in a mess 
 New Zealand 70-5 (24 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 New Zealand will look to keep the runs coming off Axar with regular singles and the odd boundary. 
 They do exactly that in the 23rd over. Three singles off the first five balls before Santner lofts Axar inside out over the covers for a boundary, the first after a gap of 63 balls. 
 Arshdeep, who bowled four overs with the new ball, is back into the attack. He replaces Brar, who bowled a sensational spell of 2/8 in six overs with two maiden overs to dismantle New Zealand in the middle overs. 
 Mitchell takes a single first ball before Santner edges the next ball but it flies wide of slip fielder for another run. 
 Arshdeep goes for the short ball but Mitchell is ready and waiting as he pulls it fine for a four. 
 10:16 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Gurnoor Brar's double strike leaves NZ in a mess 
 Gurnoor Brar 
 New Zealand 57-5 (22 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 New Zealand hit just two boundaries between the 10th and 20th over, while losing two wickets for 24 runs. 
 Mitchell reverse sweeps Axar but can't beat the fielder at point before he tries the shot off the fourth ball for a single. 
 Mitchell Santner hits the next ball through the off-side for a single and Mitchell keeps out the last ball. 
 Brar starts his sixth over with three dots in a row to Santner, who then punches a short wide ball past point for two runs. 
 That is the first runs off Brar's bowling after 14 dot balls in a row. And he ends up conceding just two runs from his sixth over. 
 10:05 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Gurnoor Brar's double strike leaves NZ in a mess 
 New Zealand 53-5 (20 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Gurnoor Brar leaves New Zealand in further strife with the wicket of Latham. The left-hander goes for the pull shot but ends up holing out a simple catch to Naman Dhir at deep square leg. 
 Latham is dismissed for a struggling seven from 22 balls as New Zealand slip to 53/4 in the 20th over. 
 Glenn Phillips once again tasked with getting New Zealand out of trouble. But he can last just four balls as he also falls to Brar. 
 The short ball once again does the damage as Phillips gets the top edge and is caught at fine leg for a four-ball duck. 
 A double wicket maiden for Brar as New Zealand slip to 53/5 in 20 overs. 
 Brar has wonderful figures of 2/6 in five overs including two maidens. 
 10:03 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Pacers put India in control as NZ struggle 
 New Zealand 53-3 (19 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Latham happy to take the singles while Mitchell has taken the odd chance in between. But the dropped catch could force Mitchell to change tactics and wait for the spinners to come on before he decides to attack again. 
 For now, the proceedings continue to drag on for New Zealand. Brar concedes just a single in his fourth over as he bowls five dots in a row to Mitchell. 
 New Zealand have scored just eight runs from the last five overs as they struggle to 48/3 in 18 overs at under three per over. 
 Time for spin as Axar Patel comes into the attack to bowl the 19th over. Latham sweeps the first ball for a single and Mitchell plays the same shot two balls later for another run. 
 New Zealand bring up their 50 from 18.3 overs. 
 Latham again swipes Axar to fine leg for a single and Mitchell takes one to long-on. 
 Latham misses the sweep but the ball beats wicketkeeper Rahul for a bye. 
 09:54 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Pacers put India in control as NZ struggle 
 New Zealand 47-3 (17 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Kamboj continues after the drinks break. Mitchell uses his feet but can only defend before he goes for the pull shot but misses and is struck on the shoulder. 
 He then gets the inside edge for a single to square leg and Latham can't get a run off the last two balls. 
 Brar follows it up with a maiden over, with a bye off a quick short ball the only run of the over. 
 They have now gone 22 balls without a boundary while the singles have also dried up. 
 New Zealand looking to break free through Mitchell but even he has been restricted by the tight lines and length from the Indian pacers. 
 The pressure pays off as Mitchell (21 from 35 balls) attempts an ugly swipe off Kamboj, miscuing it high on the off-side but Shubman Gill puts down a simple catch at mid-off. 
 In fact, Mitchell was making his way back to the pavilion and he can't believe his luck. 
 Mitchell taps Kamboj on the leg side for a single and Latham clips the fifth ball off his pads for one. 
 09:48 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: NZ struggle after early wickets; India on top 
 New Zealand 43-3 (14 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Mitchell goes after Kamboj as he swats the pacer in the gap past mid-on for a boundary.  He then hammers the next ball past the same fielder for back to back fours. 
 Mitchell keeps out the last three balls as eight runs come from the over. 
 Brar keeping it back of length to Latham, who defends the first two balls and then clips the pacer for a single. 
 Mitchell also does the same by playing two dot balls before taking one off the last ball of the over. 
 New Zealand reach 43/3 in 14 overs, at the drinks break. Mitchell has looked to break free, having made 20 from 26 balls while Latham is on three. 
 09:29 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: NZ struggle after early wickets; India on top 
 New Zealand 33-3 (12 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Kamboj beats left-hander Tom Latham on the outside edge with a superb delivery which swings away late. He guides the next ball to thirdman for a single. 
 Mitchell is struck on the pads by the incoming delivery before he uses his feet but can only tap it back to the bowler and he keeps out the last two balls. 
 Another change in the bowling as India's fourth pacer Gurnoor Brar comes into the attack in place of Nabi. 
 He starts with a leg side wide to Latham, who clips the next ball for a single. Mitchell is hurried into the pull shot as he is unable to time the shot, but it falls in the gap between midwicket and mid-on for a single. 
 Latham opens the face of the bat but can't get it past a diving Axar at point followed by another two dot balls. 
 09:23 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Kamboj, Nabi leave NZ in a mess 
 New Zealand 29-3 (10 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Mitchell keen to get going and revive New Zealand after a poor start. 
 He goes after Nabi, lofting the pacer straight down the ground for a six over long-on. 
 Mitchell keeps out the next four balls as Nabi pulls back his length slightly as New Zealand reach 29/3 in 10 overs. 
 Nabi caused the damage with the new ball, taking 2/21 in five overs. 
 Things will get a bit easier with the field spread around and the two Kiwi batters will look to work the ball in the gap and pick ones and twos to build a partnership. 
 09:14 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Kamboj, Nabi leave NZ in a mess 
 New Zealand 23-3 (9 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Anshul Kamboj, who impressed with the ball in the first ODI, comes into the attack to replace Arshdeep, who bowled a tight spell of 4-1-4-0. 
 Nicholls slashes at a length ball pitched wide but Axar's diving stop saves the boundary. 
 However, he gets a streaky boundary next ball as he gets the outside edge which falls well short of the wicketkeeper and goes in the gap between him and first slip for a four. 
 Kamboj gets Nicholls off the next ball as the left-hander manages to drag the ball on to his stumps to be bowled for 11. 
 New Zealand reeling on 23/3 in nine overs. 
 09:11 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Nabi strikes again; NZ in trouble 
 Auqib Nabi 
 New Zealand 19-2 (8 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Arshdeep has stuck on a consistent line and length as the New Zealand are struggling to get even singles off him. 
 Nicholls keeps out the first three balls before he taps Arshdeep on the leg side for one. 
 Daryl Mitchell will take time to adjust to the pace of the track as he watchfully keeps out the last two balls to end another tight over from Arshdeep. 
 New Zealand will need a few boundaries to break the shackles and get some momentum. The run rate is currently under two with 12 coming from the first seven overs. 
 A rare error from Nabi as he oversteps for a no-ball but Nicholls can't make most of the free hit delivery as he goes after the short ball but can't connect. 
 The left-hander clips the fifth ball off his pads for just a single.  
 Rahul standing up to the stumps for Mitchell, who throws his bat at a wide full delivery but gets a thick outside edge which flies over short thirdman for a four. 
 08:58 
 India vs New Zealand Live Score 2nd ODI: Nabi strikes again; NZ in trouble 
 New Zealand 11-2 (6 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Nabi gets his second wicket in his third over. The length ball moves away just enough as Young looking to defend gets the edge and wicketkeeper K L Rahul completes a superb catch diving to his right. 
 Young walks back after scoring six from 17 balls. 
 New Zealand reeling on 11/2 in the sixth over on a pitch where the ball is not coming on to the bat. 
 Nabi has been excellent with his lengths, with figures of 2/8 in three overs. 
 Arshdeep has been tight from the other end, having conceded just three runs from his three overs. 
 08:52 
 India vs New Zealand 2nd ODI Updates: Nabi strikes; New Zealand lose early wicket 
 New Zealand 6-1 (4 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Arshdeep bowls his second over. Young taps the first ball into the leg side for a single to get off the mark. 
 Nicholls clips the third ball off his pads for another run before Young plays out the last three balls to end another tidy over from Arshdeep. 
 In the next over, Nicholls nudges Nabi through square leg for a couple of runs as the fielder fails to stop the ball cleanly. 
 He misses the flick before an inswinger strikes him on the pads as Nabi gets some good movement. 
 08:40 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Nabi strikes; New Zealand lose early wicket 
 New Zealand 2-1 (2 ovs) vs India | SCORECARD 
 Auqib Nabi from the other end. He strikes in his first over with the wicket of Seifert, who is caught at mid-on for a five-ball duck. 
 The ball seems to stick on the wicket as Seifert can't find the gap with the flick and Anshul Kamboj takes a nice catch diving forward. 
 New Zealand lose their first wicket without a single run on the board. 
 That is the first international wicket for Nabi. 
 Henry Nicholls clips the last ball of the over, through square leg for a couple of runs to deny Nabi a wicket maiden and get New Zealand off the mark. 
 08:36 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: India win toss; elect to bowl vs New Zealand 
 New Zealand 0-0 (1 ov) vs India |  SCORECARD 
 Arshdeep Singh starts off with the ball for India, while Will Young and Tim Seifert are the two openers for New Zealand. 
 The first ball is full and swings into Young, who misses the clip and is struck on the pads. 
 The next ball is length and bounces extra to beat the right-hander on the outside edge before Young defends the third ball. 
 Young watchfully keeps out the fourth ball on the off-side before he is beaten on the outside edge by another cracking delivery from Arshdeep. 
 Young keeps out the last ball as Arshdeep starts with a maiden over. 
 08:15 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Unchanged India elect to bowl; 47 overs per side 
 The toss could once again prove crucial. Bowling first will favour India's pacers with the conditions overcast and the pitch kept under covers for the past few days. 
 New Zealand will be looking to bounce back with the bat but they face a tricky period against the new ball. 
 The Kiwis are aware that another victory for India could make it impossible for them to make a comeback like it happened in the T20Is.  
 Check out the playing XIs: 
 New Zealand: Will Young, Tim Seifert, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham (w/k), Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner (Captain), Nathan Smith, Kyle Jamieson, Jacob Duffy, Blair Tickner. 
 India: Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill (Captain), Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, K L Rahul (w/k), Axar Patel, Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, Arshdeep Singh 
 08:06 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Unchanged India elect to bowl; 47 overs per side 
 India captain Shubman Gill has won the toss and elected to bowl against New Zealand in the second ODI in Wellington on Saturday. 
 'No surprises with bowling first as the conditions are overcast and the wicket has been under covers for the past few days,' says Gill at the toss. 
 The start of the match, which has been delayed by an hour, has been reduced to 47 overs per side. 
 India, who won the rain-curtailed first ODI by five wickets, are playing the same team. 
 New Zealand have also not made any changes to the playing XI. 
 07:54 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Toss at 8am IST; match to start at 8.30 
 We finally have an update from Wellington. 
 The toss will take place at 3.30pm local time (8am IST) with the match scheduled to start 30 minutes later at 8.30am IST. 
 No decision yet on whether any overs will be reduced due to the delay. 
 07:41 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Toss delayed due to wet outfield 
 The groundstaff have started taking off the covers, while the players have also started warming up already. 
 The weather has cleared up and it won't be long before the toss takes place in Wellington. 
 07:24 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Rain Delays Toss In Wellington 
 The umpires will conduct another inspection at 7.45am IST. The conditions have improved and everyone is just waiting for the toss to happen and the game to get underway. 
 The weather prediction by Accuweather has issued a Thunderstorm Watch with few spells of rain likely in the evening in Wellington. 
 07:02 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Rain Delays Toss In Wellington 
 The toss has been delayed in the second ODI in Wellington on Saturday. 
 However, to the relief of cricket fans it has has stopped raining and the umpires are out to conduct an inspection. 
 'It has stopped raining and an inspection is set to take place in the next 4-5 minutes,' BCCI said on X. 
 If things stay the same, it won't be long before we get underway with the toss and the start of the game. 
 06:46 
 India vs NZ 2nd ODI Updates: Rain Delays Start In Wellington 
 Welcome to the coverage of the second One-Day International between New Zealand and India in Wellington on Saturday. 
 Rain is set to delay the start of second ODI at the Hnry Stadium in Wellington on Saturday. 
 'It's raining at the moment here in Wellington with a possibility of a delayed start,' BCCI said on X. 
 India lead the five-match ODI series 1-0 after winning the rain-curtailed first ODI in Auckland by five wickets. 
 India dismissed the Black Caps for a below-par 185 in 40.2 overs before their target was revised to 143 in 32 overs because of rain. India cruised to victory in 22.4 overs courtesy of Virat Kohli's 51-ball 74, comprising 13 boundaries and a six.
